mods.name: Combat Extended
mods.description: Server-side combat rebalance and anti-abuse layer for Minecraft combat.

releases.notes:
Combat Extended
Version: 1.0 Release

Dev Blog

⚔️ Weapon Balance
• Rebalanced the Trident. It now has 10 attack damage, 1.2 attack speed, and 4.5 block attack range.
• Added a short Bow cooldown of 0.25 seconds to reduce bow spam.
• Added a 30% attack cooldown reduction on missed melee attacks, making whiffs less punishing while still preserving weapon timing.

🏹 Bows and Crossbows
• Added support for additional Crossbow enchantments: Flame, Punch, and Infinity.
• Flame, Punch, and Infinity can now appear on Crossbows through the Enchanting Table.
• Fixed Crossbow Multishot behavior. All three arrows can now damage the same target if they actually hit.
• Bow and Crossbow damage tooltips were improved.
• Bow tooltip damage now shows a range from 1 to a calculated maximum based on vanilla bow damage and the Power enchantment.
• Crossbow tooltip damage now displays its expected damage range.

🛡️ Survivability and Anti-Abuse
• Added a Totem cooldown of 15 seconds.
• Totems can no longer activate while the cooldown is active.
• Totems are visually shown on cooldown after activation.
• Reduced player damage from End Crystals, beds, and Respawn Anchors by roughly 3x.
• This nerf only affects player damage from those special explosions, not regular explosions like TNT or creepers.

📊 Tooltips and Combat UI
• Reworked weapon tooltips to display cleaner vanilla-style combat stats.
• Tooltips now show values like:
• Attack Damage
• Attack Speed
• Attack Range
• Melee weapons now display their real calculated damage more accurately.
• Tooltip damage now accounts for weapon enchantments such as Sharpness.
• Tooltip damage now also accounts for player effects such as Strength and Weakness.
• Trident, melee weapons, bows, and crossbows now use a cleaner stat display instead of raw attribute modifier numbers.

🧱 Infrastructure
• Added the initial mod infrastructure and package layout.
• Added base combat config classes for centralized balancing.
• Added packages for combat tuning, cooldowns, damage logic, weapon logic, anti-abuse systems, utilities, registries, networking, events, and client rendering.
• Cleaned up the generated template mixin setup and replaced it with combat-focused mixins.

🪛 Fixes
• Fixed Trident attribute mapping issues for attack range.
• Fixed weapon tooltip formatting and spacing to better match vanilla.
• Fixed ugly floating-point tooltip values such as long decimal attack speeds.
• Fixed Bow and Crossbow tooltip logic so it does not modify their actual projectile damage.
• Fixed Totem cooldown world access issues on the current Minecraft/Fabric mappings.
